edges.relationship: Official SBI release confirms agreed 5% capital participation and capital/business alliance to study stablecoin services including JPYSC.
Joined Open Standard and is exploring JPYSC/OUSD interoperability proof-of-concept.
Named by SBI among more than 140 Open Standard participants; indirect consortium overlap, not a direct Coinbase-JPYSC contract.
Approximately JPY20.8B reported on Oct30 by secondary source; latest issuer-confirmed balance remains JPY20.1B as of Sep7.

hypotheses.claim: SBI/Startale are expanding JPYSC's potential interoperability beyond the initial SBI VC Trade account rail through Open Standard/OUSD and SMBC distribution partnerships.
support: Coinbase listed among Open Standard participants
counter_hypothesis: No live JPYSC/OUSD transfer or direct Coinbase-JPYSC settlement contract is established
The JPY20.8B October balance is secondary reported, not issuer confirmed
